description: Zeck sandbox-account provisioning manifest (DEP-002). Declares, per environment class, the DISPOSABLE sandbox-account set the class permits: the synthetic-data policy artifact that governs admission (cross-checked fail-closed against the frozen platform artifact in src/modules/sandbox/domain/synthetic-data-policy.ts — the ONE policy authority), the quota envelope (dimensions from the budgets module's QUOTA_DIMENSIONS vocabulary, wired to the environment-level guards in quota-guards.json), and the expiry semantics (TTL + the DEP-014 reset/post-expiry discipline). The provision tool PROJECTS these facts into per-environment sandbox-account records — it never keeps a tool-local account registry. Environments whose environments.json dataPolicy is 'authoritative' (production) declare NO sandbox accounts: disposable synthetic identities in the authoritative environment are unrepresentable.

authority.syntheticDataPolicy: src/modules/sandbox/domain/synthetic-data-policy.ts (SYNTHETIC_DATA_POLICY — the frozen, digest-carrying platform artifact; the classes declared below must EQUAL its sets)
authority.quotaDimensions: src/modules/budgets/domain/quota.ts (QUOTA_DIMENSIONS / QUOTA_WINDOWS — the budgets module stays the ONE quota authority)
authority.environmentGuards: deploy/manifests/quota-guards.json (the environment-level warn/critical thresholds the envelope wires into)

local.description: The developer workstation's disposable sandbox identity for playground/validation runs against the local control plane. Fully synthetic state; torn down with the local environment class.

preview.description: The per-branch preview deployment's disposable sandbox identity. Synthetic data only; the record set is namespaced by the preview branch slug and never promoted (preview resources are never implicitly promoted).

staging.description: The staging environment's disposable validation identity (Validation-Lab rerun path): proves production-shaped topology with disposable synthetic state. Staging itself is persistent; this ACCOUNT is disposable and resets state-non-carrying like every sandbox identity.
